name: baseline
title: Agent working rules
summary: A standing-rules file for agents (reply style, handoffs, design rulings, comments, tests, finishing work) imported from CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, plus PR guidelines — with sections that switch on for the other packs you install.

rulesImport.prompt: Which file should import the agent working rules?

choices.label: AGENTS.md
choices.description: Append the @-import to AGENTS.md and create no CLAUDE.md. Claude Code reads AGENTS.md itself, so a CLAUDE.md that only re-imports it is a second entry point to keep in step.

choices.label: CLAUDE.md
choices.description: Append the @-import to CLAUDE.md (created when missing; it also imports AGENTS.md when the repo has one).
